finding.consequence: Managed registry absence is indistinguishable from the legitimate standalone mode at this preparation boundary. The preparation proof can retain a selected binding after loss of its installed-state authority.
finding.observation: The managed live-registry check runs only when the registry file exists. Deleting the registry while retaining the owned profile and composed package leaves both preparation paths without a stale-configuration prerequisite.
finding.preserved_contract: A source-free copied operation with no owned profile or global registry remains a legitimate standalone use case. Canonical queue sharing alone does not associate an execution checkout with an installation.

limitations: This observation records deterministic local preparation behavior only. No actual agent, native Skill call, plugin execution, provider integration or candidate-efficacy qualification occurred.
The fixture used local resource acquisition and scripted test consent; the fixture supplies no real installation consent or business approval.
Temporary package/profile bytes were removed during cleanup; their before/after equality booleans are observed, while exact values were not retained.
Actual runtime dispatch after registry deletion was not attempted.
method: Create an isolated temporary checkout, installed project and controlled local SKILL.md source.
Install the selected core operation; prepare and apply the controlled plugin lifecycle proposal with explicitly scripted fixture confirmation; refresh the owned profile.
Read baseline runtime.freezePlan proof. Retain the registry bytes, owned profile bytes and composed manifest bytes.
Delete only the managed registry file; obtain freezePlan and occurrencePlan proofs against the retained compiled configuration.
Copy the operation into an independent directory and prepare the copied operation against an empty project with no owned profile or global registry.
Restore the exact original registry bytes; prepare and apply normal exact-ID lifecycle uninstall; obtain both proofs from the old composed operation.
Remove the complete temporary fixture tree.

provenance.observations_retained_as: Exact scalar proof fields from the completed local probe output; no unobserved profile or manifest digest values are asserted.

source_identity.current_worktree_hash_note: Current worktree hashes are recording-time measurements during task117 development, not additional probe observations.
source_identity.method: The probe extracted the exact .skill-tree Git archive at the reported source commit into a temporary checkout and installed from that checkout. Hashes below were reconstructed from the same pinned Git blobs when recording this observation.

triage.recommendation: Capture a separate hardening Pending item, nonblocking for inventory/removal task117, and require the managed-registry-absence control before the future Ponytail pilot116 relies on stale-configuration gating.
triage.suggested_acceptance: An actually associated owned installation with a registry requirement returns an explicit prerequisite when the live registry is absent or unreadable; standalone copies without an owned profile/global registry remain usable.
